description_en: Creates an embodied intelligence multimodal data platform

kebab_example: aliyun adbai create-embodied-ai-platform --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --platform-name platform1 --webserver-spec-name large --ray-config '{"HeadSpec":"xlarge","Category":"BASIC","WorkerGroups":[{"GroupName":"test","MinWorkerQuantity":1,"MaxWorkerQuantity":2,"WorkerSpecName":"xlarge","WorkerDiskCapacity":"100G","WorkerSpecType":"CPU","AllocateUnit":"1"}]}' --device-count 3 --ray-train-config '{"GpuSpecs":[{"AllocateUnit":"1","SpecName":"ADB.MLGrand.4","Count":1}],"TerminalConfig":{"AcrConfig":{"Namespaces":["devops"],"InstanceId":"cri-000","Registry":"example-vpc.example-region.cr.aliyuncs.com"}},"CpuAcu":1}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEmbodiedAIPlatform
